description: Probe-only alignment evidence for Matmul, not a shape space: one fixed float batched matmul (A [3,16,32] x B [3,32,128] = C [3,16,128], dense row-major, quick Matmul/Default template) whose only axes are the declared alignment of A, B and C (tensor_patches on uids 1, 2, 0) and the placement of the device pointers. It exists to show whether MIOpen and hipBLASLt honor a declared alignment of 16 and decline the rest through the version gate: exact puts every device pointer at exactly the declared alignment, under misaligns A (placement_uid 1) below it and passes only if the backend rejects that pointer (drawn as exact at alignment 1), default leaves the pointers where they are.

derive.eff_placement: 'exact' if placement == 'under' and alignment < 2 else placement
